systemManagement.pageDescription: View the service runtime environment and adjust the JVM max heap. Changes take effect after the service restarts
systemManagement.hint: The config is read at JVM startup; changes require a service restart to take effect. Restarting briefly interrupts the service, so use with care.
systemManagement.saved: Saved. Restart the service to apply.
systemManagement.restartingTip: Applying new config. The page may briefly disconnect; refresh shortly.
systemManagement.restartProbeTimeout: Taking longer than expected. The service may still be starting — refresh manually later to confirm.
systemManagement.restartDoneDesc: The new JVM memory config is active and page data has been refreshed.
systemManagement.restartConfirmDesc: The backend will restart with the latest JVM heap config. The service will briefly interrupt and this page may disconnect. Continue?
systemManagement.invalidValue: Enter an integer between 256 and 65536, or blank for JVM default

featureToggles.pageDescription: Turn system features on or off. Changes apply to all users
featureToggles.favoriteDesc: When enabled, the Favorites entry appears in the sidebar
featureToggles.historyDesc: When enabled, the Recents entry appears in the sidebar
featureToggles.recycleBinDesc: When enabled, deleted files move to the Recycle Bin and can be restored. When disabled, deletion permanently removes files
featureToggles.shareDesc: When enabled, the Share entry appears on the files page for creating share links. When disabled, the entry is hidden while existing share links remain accessible

userManagement.pageDescription: Manage all accounts: create, review, enable/disable, reset passwords, force sign-out and delete
userManagement.createDescription: Manually created accounts skip approval and can sign in immediately
userManagement.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
userManagement.created: User {{name}} created and ready to sign in
userManagement.unlocked: Unlocked. The account can sign in again
userManagement.approved: Approved. The user can now sign in
userManagement.confirmRejectDesc: After rejection, {{name}} will not be able to sign in.
userManagement.editDescription: The username is the sign-in identifier and cannot be changed. Only the nickname can be edited.
userManagement.resetDescription: Set a new password for {{name}}. All online sessions of the account will be signed out.
userManagement.resetDone: Password reset. All sessions of the account have been signed out
userManagement.enabled: Account enabled. The user can sign in again
userManagement.disabled: Account disabled. Its online sessions have been signed out
userManagement.confirmDisableDesc: {{name}} will be signed out immediately and cannot sign in again until re-enabled.
userManagement.kickDone: Signed out {{n}} sessions of the account
userManagement.confirmKickDesc: All {{n}} online sessions of {{name}} will be signed out.
userManagement.deleteNoData: This account has no files, shares or other residual data. Deletion cannot be undone.
userManagement.residualIntro: The account still has the following data. Choose how to proceed:
userManagement.deleteDisableOnlyHint: Keep all data. The account cannot sign in and can be enabled later
userManagement.deletePurgeHint: Delete the account and all data above. This cannot be undone
userManagement.deleted: Account {{name}} and its data have been deleted

loginManagement.pageDescription: Review online accounts and devices, and force any account offline
loginManagement.kicked: That device has been signed out
loginManagement.kickedAll: All {{n}} sessions of this account have been signed out
loginManagement.actionFailed: Action failed, please refresh and retry
loginManagement.confirmKickDesc: {{name}} will be asked to sign in again on that device.
loginManagement.confirmKickSelfDesc: This is the session you are using now. You will also be signed out and sent back to the sign-in page.
loginManagement.confirmKickAllDesc: All {{n}} online sessions of {{name}} will be signed out.
loginManagement.confirmKickAllSelfWarning: That includes the session you are using now, so you will be signed out too.

appearance.pageDescription: Customize theme and display preferences, including light and dark mode.
appearance.themeDescription: Choose how the app looks and switch between light and dark.
appearance.languageDescription: Choose which language you want to use
appearance.thumbnailsDescription: Show preview thumbnails in the file list and grid views. When off, file type icons are shown instead.

transfer.speedLimitDesc: Limit maximum bandwidth used when downloading.
transfer.concurrentUploadDesc: How many files to upload at the same time
transfer.concurrentDownloadDesc: How many files to download at the same time
transfer.chunkSizeDesc: Upload chunk size; 5 MB is recommended
transfer.autoNavigate: Go to progress page after adding tasks
transfer.autoNavigateDesc: When enabled, adding an upload/download task navigates to the transfer page; when disabled you stay on the current page, and returning from the transfer page restores your folder

profile.pageDescription: Manage your profile, sign-in details, and security.

validation.nicknameMin: Nickname must be at least 2 characters
validation.nicknameMax: Nickname must be at most 20 characters

account.passwordHint: Set a password for sign-in and sensitive actions.
account.dialogSetPwdDesc: You haven’t set a password yet. After setting one, you can sign in with username and password.
account.dialogChangePwdDesc: Enter your current and new password. Use the new password to sign in after saving.

validation.newPwdMin: New password must be at least 6 characters
validation.newPwdMax: New password must be at most 32 characters

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.description: You don’t have permission to view this page. Contact an administrator.
